title: Clinical and Laboratory Online Patient- and Research Registry for Primary Immunodeficiencies of the European Society for Immunodeficiencies (ESID)
summary: The Registry provides long term documentation of patients with primary (inborn) immunodeficiencies. These include e.g. common variable immunodeficiency (CVID) and severe combined immunodeficiency (SCID). The registry data makes it possible to determine the frequency of single diseases, as well as possible factors that may be related to the benefit of specific therapies.
conditions: Immunodeficiency associated with other major defects

interventions.name: Baseline documentation: Age, sex, familial cases, first symptoms, diagnosis, haemtopoietic stem cell transplantation (HSCT), immunoglobulin replacement (Ig replacement), lab values, clinical features; Yearly follow-up: living status, therapy status (HSCT, Ig replacement), changes to diagnosis, lab v

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Diagnosis of a primary immunodeficiency
Exclusion criteria:
Diagnosis of a secondary immunodeficiency
